userStories.title: Prisma Schema Additions for Phase 4
userStories.description: Add durable Phase 4 models: GraphNode, GraphLink, EntityNode, EntityLink, and Symbol. These are the persistence foundation for incremental graph diffing, symbol indexing, entity graph traversal, and impact analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: GraphNode includes: id, projectId, nodeId, label, type, sourceFile, community, metadata, indexedAt; unique(projectId, nodeId); index(projectId).

GraphLink includes: id, projectId, sourceGraphNodeId, targetGraphNodeId, relation; unique(projectId, sourceGraphNodeId, targetGraphNodeId, relation); indexes on projectId, sourceGraphNodeId, targetGraphNodeId.
EntityNode includes: id, projectId, entityId, type, label, tags, sourceType, sourceId, metadata, createdAt, updatedAt; unique(projectId, entityId); index(projectId, type).

EntityLink includes: id, projectId, sourceEntityNodeId, targetEntityNodeId, relation, confidence, sourceType, sourceId, createdAt; unique(projectId, sourceEntityNodeId, targetEntityNodeId, relation); indexes on projectId, sourceEntityNodeId, targetEntityNodeId.

Symbol includes: id, projectId, symbolId, repoId, commitHash, name, kind, file, startLine, endLine, signature, callers, callees, docComment, indexedAt; unique(projectId, symbolId); indexes on (projectId, repoId) and (projectId, commitHash).
All array/object fields are persisted as JSON-encoded strings for SQLite compatibility.
Foreign keys to graph/entity nodes use cascade semantics so dependent links are cleaned automatically when parent nodes are deleted.

routing.noTestJustification: Schema changes are validated by Prisma schema validation and migration tooling.

suggestedCriteria: Prisma migration applies cleanly on SQLite and existing data is preserved.
Schema validation fails if any Phase 4 JSON-like field is changed to scalar-list or provider-specific JSON type.

userStories.title: Incremental Graph Diff — Replace Full Re-Import
userStories.description: Replace full graphify re-import with incremental diff-and-apply against durable graph tables, while preserving existing import API behavior and project isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: IncrementalGraphDiffService.diffAndApply() computes a diff and applies only the delta.
Stored graph is loaded from GraphNode + GraphLink Prisma tables; not from LanceDB.
When newNodes has 100 and stored has 90, added=10 and removed=0.
When a stored node is absent from newNodes, it is deleted from both GraphNode table and LanceDB (by graphify nodeId / RAG sourceId).
When a node exists in both with unchanged content, it is skipped (no re-index).
diffAndApply is called by the existing importGraphify endpoint (replacing deleteAllBySourceType behavior).
DiffResult.indexed reflects only nodes actually written to LanceDB.
A diff-and-apply of 500 unchanged + 10 added + 5 removed completes under 2 seconds.
DiffResult includes durationMs.
Only actors with role admin, developer, or agent can call importGraphify (controller-level enforcement).
Existing graphify imports remain project-scoped and continue to honor Project.graphifyEnabled.
suggestedCriteria: When outgoing links change for an otherwise unchanged node, that node is treated as updated and re-indexed.
Stale GraphLink rows for removed/updated nodes are removed as part of the same apply cycle.
If LanceDB write/delete fails, affected graph delta is not left partially applied and reconciliation is recorded for retry.

userStories.title: AST/Symbol Index Pipeline
userStories.description: Add deterministic ts-morph-based symbol indexing for changed commit files, durable Symbol storage, and caller/callee query support. Trigger asynchronously via code_commit outbox events.
acceptanceCriteria: AstIndexService.indexCommit() parses source files and stores symbol metadata in Symbol table.
Symbol.symbolId uses {repoId}:{filePath}::{SymbolName} and is globally unique within a project.
getCallers(symbolId) returns all symbols that include this symbol in their JSON callers list.
getCallees(symbolId) returns all symbols in this symbol's JSON callees list.
When indexCommit is called with files=[{path:'src/auth.ts', content:'...'}], only src/auth.ts is parsed and unchanged-file symbols are preserved.
Symbol.signature captures parameter types and return type.
Indexing is triggered by code_commit outbox event (from webhook flow in US-004).
A commit with 20 files averaging 200 lines each is indexed under 30 seconds.
Only admin/developer can call indexCommit directly (agents rejected) with controller-level enforcement.
Parser failures for one file are recorded and do not block indexing other files in the same commit.
The code_commit handler resolves changed file contents before calling indexCommit; webhook controller only enqueues commit metadata.
suggestedCriteria: Overloaded or nested symbol collisions append deterministic parser-derived suffixes (#2, #3...) and remain stable across re-indexes of unchanged declarations.
When a referenced callee symbol is not yet indexed, its symbolId is still persisted as a string reference without failing the file.
callers/callees JSON-string fields round-trip to arrays without data loss.
Outbox fan-out registry includes a code_commit handler registration and invokes it for pending code_commit events.

userStories.title: Ticket/Entity Graph Builder
userStories.description: Implement durable entity graph persistence and traversal APIs, with incremental updates from ticket events and graphify imports.
acceptanceCriteria: EntityGraphService.rebuildGraph(projectId) rebuilds all entity nodes and links for a project.
Entity graph data is persisted in EntityNode and EntityLink tables, not only in in-memory EntityStore.

onTicketEvent(event) updates the entity node for the referenced ticket when it exists, covering status changes, assignment changes (assignedToUserId/assignedToAgentId), priority changes, and incident linking events; unhandled event kinds are a no-op.
onGraphifyImport() extracts service entities from graphify nodes with type=code_module.
Initial implementation does not require Ticket.serviceId; service linkage uses current Koda fields (gitRefFile, labels, linked code/module references).
getRelatedEntities(projectId, entityId, depth=2) returns all entities reachable within 2 hops.
getIncidentImpact(projectId, incidentTicketId) returns all entities linked to the incident.
Service entities from graphify inherit tags from graphify nodes.
Entity graph updates incrementally via outbox fan-out (no full rebuild on every event).
A graph with 500 nodes and 2000 edges returns getRelatedEntities in under 50ms.
suggestedCriteria: Inference precedence is deterministic: code/module references first, gitRefFile-derived mapping second, labels third.
When no service can be inferred for a ticket, ticket node still updates and service link is omitted or stored with low confidence.
getRelatedEntities(depth=0) returns only the requested entity when present.
Traversal is implemented with batched per-hop queries to avoid N+1 database access patterns.

userStories.title: VCS Webhook Handler → code_commit Outbox Event
userStories.description: Extend existing project-scoped VCS webhook handling to enqueue code_commit events for push commits, preserving signature validation and asynchronous indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: VcsWebhookController extends POST /projects/:slug/vcs-webhook to handle push/code-intel events.
Webhook payload validation requires repository identifier, ref, commits array, and sender identifier.
For each commit in push payload, enqueue code_commit outbox event with { repoId, commitHash, ref, changedFiles }.
AstIndexService.indexCommit() is called by code_commit outbox handler, not synchronously by webhook controller.
If enqueue fails, webhook logs failure and returns non-2xx for provider retry.
GitHub signature verification reuses existing x-hub-signature-256 flow; invalid signatures return 401.
Webhook secret comes from project VCS connection record (never hard-coded).
Webhook handler is idempotent: same commitHash within 5 minutes does not create duplicate outbox events.
suggestedCriteria: Dedup scope is projectId + repoId + commitHash within the 5-minute window.
A multi-commit push enqueues one code_commit event per commit.
changedFiles payload is merged from added/modified/removed with duplicates removed before enqueue.
Missing or malformed signature header returns 401 without leaking project existence.

userStories.title: Expose getChangeImpact API
userStories.description: Add project-scoped code-intel impact endpoint combining symbol index and entity graph to return impacted symbols, services, tickets, and composite impact score.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /projects/:slug/codeintel/impact?repoId=X&commitHash=Y&changedFiles=file1,file2 returns a ChangeImpactResult.
impactedSymbols contains symbols whose file matches changedFiles entries.
impactedServices contains service entities linked to impacted symbols through Symbol.file -> GraphNode.sourceFile or EntityNode.sourceId.
impactedTickets contains tickets linked to impactedServices.
impactScore is 0-100 and computed with the specified weighted formula and denominator guards.
When ticketId is supplied, provenance includes source metadata pointing to that ticket.
Endpoint returns under 5 seconds for commit touching up to 50 files.
Only admin, developer, or agent can call the endpoint.

routing.reasoning: SPEC labels this Medium based on AC/file count, but raised to complex here: integrates three independent stores (Symbol, GraphNode, EntityNode→Ticket) with cross-store path normalization, implements a 4-term weighted impactScore with denominator guards and [0,100] clamping, and structurally depends on US-001, US-002, and US-003 all landing correctly. Risk profile is closer to US-002 than to US-004.

suggestedCriteria: Path normalization is applied before cross-store matching (separator normalization, repo-root prefix removal, leading './' removal).
When no symbols/services/tickets are found, impactScore returns 0 and arrays are empty.
Score is clamped to [0,100] after computing all components.
If changedFiles is empty, impactedSymbols/Services/Tickets are empty and response is still 200 with impactScore 0.

userStories.title: CanonicalStateService Snapshot Read Layer
userStories.description: Introduce a thin authoritative Prisma-only read service for project snapshots (tickets, recent events, active decisions), designed for Phase 5 consumers without coupling to derived stores.
acceptanceCriteria: CanonicalStateService.getSnapshot(query) returns retrievedAt set to server timestamp.
When ticketIds are provided, tickets include only rows in requested projectId.
When timeWindow is provided, recentEvents includes only events in-window ordered by createdAt DESC.
activeDecisions is populated from active MemoryItem rows with kind='DECISION'.
Non-existent or unauthorized projectId throws existing KodaError/Nathapp-style exception.
Service performs Prisma reads only and does not query LanceDB, BM25, entity graph, or other derived stores.

routing.reasoning: Thin Prisma read layer over existing Ticket/TicketEvent/AgentEvent/DecisionEvent/MemoryItem tables. Per SPEC §6, introduces no new tables, so does not depend on US-000 schema additions.

suggestedCriteria: recentEvents is a union of TicketEvent, AgentEvent, and DecisionEvent normalized to one response shape.
When ticketIds is omitted, tickets is empty.
When no active decisions exist, activeDecisions is empty.
A limit is applied to recentEvents to prevent unbounded payload size.

priorFailures.summary: Failed with tier fast, escalating to next tier

reviewFindings.message: AC5 not fully implemented: The controller/service does not verify project membership/authorization. Unlike other project-scoped controllers (e.g., projects.controller.ts:42-96), there is no @CurrentUser() decorator, no checkProjectMembership() call, and no ForbiddenAppException for unauthorized project access. An authenticated user who lacks project access will receive data instead of a 403.

analysis:
Baseline: Proposal codex for repo-grounded integration points, with Proposal opencode’s concrete file mapping and Proposal claude’s explicit schema foundation. Scope is additive and phase-safe: durable graph/code intelligence in Phase 4 without replacing Phase 2 retrieval scoring, Phase 3 semantic memory extraction, or Phase 5 context assembly.

Pre-resolved implementation decisions for known gaps:
1) Entity inference rules are deterministic and ordered: ticket→service linking uses explicit code/module references first, then gitRefFile path heuristics, then labels; unresolved links are retained with lower confidence.
2) Symbol collision handling is deterministic: symbolId base is {repoId}:{normalizedFilePath}::{qualifiedName}; overloads/nesting append stable parser-derived suffixes (#2, #3...) by declaration order within the same scope.
3) Prisma/LanceDB consistency uses staged apply with reconciliation markers: Prisma graph delta and LanceDB writes are treated as one logical operation; on LanceDB failure, node/link mutation is not left partially committed for affected nodes and reconciliation is queued.
4) Webhook dedup scope is [projectId, repoId, commitHash] over a 5-minute window using OutboxEvent lookup on code_commit payload metadata.
5) Graph traversal for depth queries uses batched edge/node reads per hop (no per-node query loops) to meet the 50ms target on 500/2000 graphs.
6) CanonicalStateService interface is explicit and Prisma-read-only, with bounded recentEvents output.
7) Outbox fan-out ownership is explicit: code_commit registration lives in outbox fan-out registry initialization; handler resolves file contents then calls AstIndexService.
8) Path normalization is required before joins/matching across Symbol.file, GraphNode.sourceFile, and entity provenance fields.
9) OpenAPI/client regeneration is required after endpoint contract changes (`bun run generate`) and must compile.
10) Observability is mandatory on critical paths (diff duration/counts, indexing duration/fileErrors, webhook enqueue/dedup decisions, impact latency).
